operations.name: read_bar0_offset
operations.desc: Read 32-bit value from BAR0 at specified offset

operations.name: read_pci_config
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0xcf8
mov edx, ebx
out dx, eax
mov eax, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: detect_device_status
operations.desc: Detect if device is present and functional
operations.returns: 0 = not present, 1 = present, eax = device status flags
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0xcf8
mov edx, 0x80000000
or edx, ebx
out dx, eax
mov eax, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
cmp eax, 0xffffffff
jne .present
xor eax, eax
ret
.present:
mov eax, 1
ret

operations.name: read_device_id
operations.desc: Read vendor and device ID from config space
operations.returns: eax = 0x8086 (vendor) in high word, device ID in low word
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0xcf8
mov edx, 0x80000000
or edx, ebx
out dx, eax
mov eax, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
ret

operations.name: check_bar0_enabled
operations.desc: Check if BAR0 is mapped and enabled
operations.returns: eax = BAR0 address if enabled, 0 if disabled
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, 0xcf8
mov edx, 0x80000010
or edx, ebx
out dx, eax
mov eax, 0xcfc
in eax, dx
and eax, 0xfffffff0
ret
